mysterymaps

Source: CLAUDE.md

An R package of map-construction functions for healthcare access and mystery-caller studies: county choropleths, dissolved drive-time coverage surfaces, provider dot maps, and the legend/label/notes furniture they need. mysterymaps_county_access_map() assembles the common case from pieces that are also exported individually.

Read CONTRIBUTING.md before changing anything. It carries the rules below and the bugs that produced them. The short version:

Before writing a helper, look for it

This ecosystem has repeatedly grown the same function twice, with load order deciding which one runs and a fix to one copy fixing neither. Search the cross-repo index first (~/muffly-refs/FUNCTION_INDEX.tsv), and add genuinely new capability to the package that should own it — mufflyaccess for constants and safe arithmetic, twostep for accessibility, isochrones for routing and water masks, mysterymaps for map construction.

Conventions

  • Exported functions are mysterymaps_* and carry no single study’s specifics.
  • Comment why, not what — which bug a line prevents is why it survives review.
  • Guards error; they do not silently filter. Dropping rows moves a denominator invisibly.
  • Mapping packages are Suggests, guarded with requireNamespace().
  • Roxygen with markdown. @param types go in backticks — `character(1)`, never [character(1)], which roxygen renders as a link to a topic that does not exist and R CMD check flags.
  • Keep Rd prose ASCII. Em dashes and ² survive the build but trip the HTML manual validator.

NAMESPACE is generated — never hand-edit

It has twice silently stopped being roxygen-managed here (a stray blank line above the # Generated by roxygen2 marker; a rebase resolved by side-picking). Both times roxygen printed Skipping NAMESPACE, kept writing man pages, and install reported DONE with stale exports. If an export seems to vanish, check line 1 of NAMESPACE first.

Checks

devtools::document()
devtools::test()
devtools::check()
Rscript data-raw/make_readme_figures.R   # if map output changed

ggmap and hereR are Suggests that may not be installed; use _R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_=false to check without them. The mysterycall dependency is GitHub-only (see Remotes:), so R CMD check --as-cran warns about it by design — the package is not currently CRAN-bound.
